veranderings.blok: Alles nog waar dit gelaat is
veranderings.rede: The block never names Toetankamen and the nearest possessor is 'ander konings', so 'Sy' has no clear referent when the block is read on its own.
'wat ons vertel' can be read as 'which we tell'; 'vir ons' makes 'ons' the indirect object, so the definition reads unambiguously as 'that tells us'.

vlae.rede: In Afrikaans ''n ou mens' normally means an elderly person, but Toetankamen died at about 19; the heading probably means someone from long ago. A heading may not be changeable by script, and choosing a replacement word risks content, so the writer should choose the wording.
